verses.text: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
lines: Don’t fret because of evildoers,
neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

verses.text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
lines: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass,
and wither like the green herb.

verses.text: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
lines: Trust in Yahweh, and do good.
Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

verses.text: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
lines: Also delight yourself in Yahweh,
and he will give you the desires of your heart.

verses.text: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
lines: Commit your way to Yahweh.
Trust also in him, and he will do this:

verses.text: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
lines: he will make your righteousness shine out like light,
and your justice as the noon day sun.

verses.text: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
lines: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him.
Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way,
because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

verses.text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.
lines: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath.
Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

verses.text: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
lines: For evildoers shall be cut off,
but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.

verses.text: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
lines: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more.
Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

verses.text: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
lines: But the humble shall inherit the land,
and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

verses.text: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
lines: The wicked plots against the just,
and gnashes at him with his teeth.

verses.text: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
lines: The Lord will laugh at him,
for he sees that his day is coming.

verses.text: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
lines: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow,
to cast down the poor and needy,
to kill those who are upright on the path.

verses.text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
lines: Their sword shall enter into their own heart.
Their bows shall be broken.

verses.text: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
lines: Better is a little that the righteous has,
than the abundance of many wicked.

verses.text: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.
lines: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken,
but Yahweh upholds the righteous.

verses.text: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
lines: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect.
Their inheritance shall be forever.

verses.text: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
lines: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil.
In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

verses.text: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
lines: But the wicked shall perish.
The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields.
They will vanish—
vanish like smoke.

verses.text: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
lines: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back,
but the righteous give generously.

verses.text: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
lines: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land.
Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

verses.text: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
lines: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh.
He delights in his way.

verses.text: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
lines: Though he stumble, he shall not fall,
for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.

verses.text: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
lines: I have been young, and now am old,
yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken,
nor his children begging for bread.

verses.text: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.
lines: All day long he deals graciously, and lends.
His offspring is blessed.

verses.text: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
lines: Depart from evil, and do good.
Live securely forever.

verses.text: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
lines: For Yahweh loves justice,
and doesn’t forsake his saints.
They are preserved forever,
but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.text: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
lines: The righteous shall inherit the land,
and live in it forever.

verses.text: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
lines: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom.
His tongue speaks justice.

verses.text: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
lines: The law of his God is in his heart.
None of his steps shall slide.

verses.text: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
lines: The wicked watch the righteous,
and seek to kill him.

verses.text: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
lines: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand,
nor condemn him when he is judged.

verses.text: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
lines: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way,
and he will exalt you to inherit the land.
When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

verses.text: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
lines: I have seen the wicked in great power,
spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

verses.text: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
lines: But he passed away, and behold, he was not.
Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

verses.text: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
lines: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright,
for there is a future for the man of peace.

verses.text: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
lines: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together.
The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.text: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
lines: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh.
He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

verses.text: Yahweh helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
lines: Yahweh helps them and rescues them.
He rescues them from the wicked and saves them,
because they have taken refuge in him.
